title: Two Restatements, remedies, and the scope of reliance
shortTitle: Two Restatements, remedies, and the scope of reliance
summary: The wording changes to § 90 bear both on who may rely and on what relief follows.
notes: The first version’s definite-and-substantial language and Williston’s discussion of enforcing the promise should be compared with the second version’s qualified remedy language. The charitable provision is an additional rule, not simply a finding of ordinary factual reliance. The Gilmore discussion concerns the larger relation between contract and reliance; it does not erase the separate elements in the assigned cases.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 126–130. Open assigned page 126.
